title: shell-tools dependencies
description: The crates shell-tools depends on and why; each has one reason.

entities.title: blake3
entities.relevance: fsio::etag hashes file bytes and reply values; the first 8 hex digits equal the sha zazzle read shows.

entities.title: libc
entities.summary: O_NOATIME, posix_fadvise and, in tests, mkfifo.
entities.relevance: fsio opens files without updating access times on Linux and hints sequential reads.

entities.title: memchr
entities.relevance: read slices lines and search finds line starts with it.

entities.title: regex
entities.relevance: search compiles the pattern (literal, ignore_case, multi-line) and hands it to the daemon's scan; the same crate the daemon uses.

entities.title: serde and serde_json
entities.relevance: req.rs derives one strict argument struct per operation; replies are serde_json values.

entities.title: similar
entities.relevance: diff::hunks turns a stored version into the current one, with a 250 ms timeout.

entities.title: tempfile (tests only)
entities.relevance: Unit tests write their files under a fresh directory.
